entry.focal: The vanishing point of a dark, even corridor of niche cubes; a faint pale patch on the water near the end. The lip is invisible.
entry.next_visible: Glacier door on the right shows the brown back of the glacier's ice wall; the end of the spur is a dark wall.

reveal.focal: A lantern_stone block 1 m in front of the camera and teal water planes. No shaft, no glowing sheet.

concept.focal: Niche cubes and the pale patch at the end. It's a copy of the mist corridor with no climax.

strip.focal: The strip covers only the 5 m dogleg from cor_north to the glacier door, so the viewing spur and lip aren't in it. Frames show the glacier's brown ice slab through the door and a few lanterns.

fixes.detail: spill_lip sits at z -20.6 with h 0.4, so it is entirely below the floor and invisible, and it has no light. Seat its top flush with the water (-20.05) at x 191.6. Cut the floor and ceiling open over x 192-194 so the shaft void reads. Add the warm under-light from the spec (~300-500 W, 2400 K, at about z -21.5 inside the shaft, aimed up at the falling sheet) so a glowing edge is the only bright thing at the end.
Toro is sunk 0.6 m (z -20.6), so set it to -20.0. It also sits 1.2 m in front of the reveal camera and fills the frame; moving it to x ~186.9 on the same kerb lets it frame the lip from the side.

Five niches at an even ~6 m spacing on two walls, ending at x 180, leave the last 10 m before the lip a dead black stretch with an unlit end. Keep the dark run-up, but it only works once the lip glows. Otherwise place 2 niches closer together at x 186-188 as a threshold.

13 boulders in two ruler-straight rows at exactly y 98.45 / 101.55, all facing 0/180 and submerged (z -20.4). Seat them on the bed, randomise yaw, and cluster them at the lip (where the water accelerates) and at the cor_north mouth; leave the middle clean.
Once the shaft is open, move the reveal to (189.6, 100.3, -18.4) aimed at (193, 100, -26) so it looks over the rail into the lit drop.

top_change: Make the lip exist: seat the spill_lip at water level, open the shaft, and light the falling sheet from below so the dark spur ends in one glowing edge.
plausibility: Hero spill_lip and lip_toro are sunk 0.6 m below the floor.
There's no visible opening at the lip: water runs to a solid end wall, so it couldn't drain 22 m.
